assets.scene_prompt: Andalusian olive plains: open pale wheat and ochre plains across the center; ancient olive trees and a few holm oaks frame outer edges; blue Sierra ridges far away. No buildings.

Create one standalone 16:9 landscape background illustration for a literary reading interface, no UI, no text, no labels, no frame, no people. Extremely sparse hand-drawn pencil and dry-brush watercolor on pale paper, unfinished sketchbook with delicate visible broken strokes. Composition is paramount: top 65 percent is almost empty pale paper with only the faintest tint, middle 45 percent of width remains almost empty throughout, all visually interesting landscape detail clustered in the bottom left and bottom right corners, landscape no higher than bottom 30 percent. Low contrast, restrained sophisticated pigments, evocative Quixotic Iberian landscape, not fantasy game art. Wide 1536x1024 or wider landscape image. Warm ivory paper, dusty rose washes, muted terracotta and graphite. Two tiny old La Mancha windmills at bottom left amid barely suggested grasses, distant chalk ridge, loose olive grove twigs and rocky ground bottom right. Mostly drawing with sparing color. No technological elements.
